routine.label: Routine / Maintenance Cleaning
routine.title: Consistent care for a permanently polished environment.
routine.description: We provide scheduled maintenance cleaning that keeps residential and commercial spaces fresh, hygienic, and presentable throughout the week. Our trained team follows a detailed cleaning plan tailored to your property, schedule, and high-traffic areas.
routine.imageBeforeAlt: Routine maintenance before state showing light surface dust
routine.imageAfterAlt: Routine maintenance after state showing a fresh, presentable environment

checklist.dusting: Dusting of furniture and accessible surfaces
checklist.vacuuming: Vacuuming of carpets, rugs, and upholstery
checklist.mopping: Sweeping and mopping of hard floors
checklist.kitchen: Kitchen surface and appliance exterior cleaning
checklist.handles: Door handle and high-touch point disinfection

deep.label: Deep Cleaning
deep.title: Intensive cleaning beyond the visible surface.
deep.description: Our deep-cleaning service targets accumulated dirt, grease, limescale, dust, and hidden residue throughout the property. We clean overlooked areas, detailed fixtures, and hard-to-reach spaces to restore a noticeably fresher and more hygienic environment.
deep.imageBeforeAlt: Deep Cleaning before state showing hidden residue and accumulated dirt
deep.imageAfterAlt: Deep Cleaning after state showing fully restored clean property

checklist.dusting: Detailed surface and furniture dust removal
checklist.vents: Vent, grille, and accessible fixture dusting

construction.label: Post-Construction / Renovation Cleaning
construction.title: Precision removal of construction dust and residue.
construction.description: We transform newly built or renovated spaces into clean, safe, and presentation-ready environments. Our team removes fine construction dust, paint marks, adhesive residue, packaging debris, and surface contamination without damaging newly installed finishes.
construction.imageBeforeAlt: Post-Construction showing fine dust, packaging, and debris

checklist.detailing: Floor, wall, and skirting board detailing
checklist.residue: Adhesive, silicone, and label residue treatment

corporate.label: Offices and Corporate Cleaning
corporate.title: Professional cleaning for productive workplaces.
corporate.description: We maintain clean, organized, and hygienic working environments that reflect the standards of your business. Services can be arranged before, during, or after working hours, with customized schedules for offices of every size.

drycleaning.label: Dry Cleaning
drycleaning.title: Low-moisture treatment for delicate textiles.
drycleaning.description: Our professional dry-cleaning process refreshes moisture-sensitive carpets, rugs, upholstery, curtains, and fabric surfaces without excessive saturation. Specialized cleaning compounds help lift surface oils, dust, odours, and localized stains while protecting delicate fibres and finishes.
drycleaning.imageBeforeAlt: Delicate textiles with embedded dust and stains
drycleaning.imageAfterAlt: Refreshed and realigned pristine textile fabric

pressure.label: Pressure Washing
pressure.title: High-pressure restoration for durable stone and tiled surfaces.
pressure.description: We remove embedded dirt, atmospheric residue, algae, staining, and surface buildup from granite slabs, paving stones, ceramic tiles, and marble. Pressure levels and cleaning methods are carefully adjusted according to the material and condition of each surface.
pressure.imageBeforeAlt: Stone surface with algae and atmospheric buildup

facade.label: Exterior Building and Facade Cleaning
facade.title: Professional exterior care from ground level to height.
facade.description: We restore the appearance of building exteriors by removing dust, pollution, water marks, organic buildup, and weather-related staining. Our team selects appropriate equipment and methods for glass, stone, metal, cladding, render, and other facade materials.
facade.imageBeforeAlt: Building exterior with weather staining and pollution marks

chandelier.label: Chandelier Cleaning
chandelier.title: Detailed care for chandeliers of every type and size.
chandelier.description: We clean chandeliers with precision, protecting delicate crystals, glass pieces, metal frames, decorative elements, and electrical components. Each fixture is assessed individually and cleaned using controlled methods suitable for its material, size, and installation height.
chandelier.imageBeforeAlt: Chandelier with dusty crystals and dull metal frame
chandelier.imageAfterAlt: Brilliant chandelier with polished crystals and alignment

checklist.residue: Safe removal of fingerprints and residue

windows.label: Window Cleaning
windows.title: Streak-free clarity for windows of all types and sizes.
windows.description: We professionally clean residential, commercial, interior, exterior, high-level, and specialist window systems. Our methods remove dust, fingerprints, water marks, pollution, and environmental residue while protecting glass, frames, seals, and surrounding finishes.
windows.imageBeforeAlt: Window glass with fingerprints and water marks
